images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production Spine texture sheet repaint. Image 1 is EXACT layout / silhouette / orientation reference, image 2 approved character design ONLY for color and materials. Output TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG, keep every part in its exact original 4 by 4 cell, same silhouette proportions, no labels, no grid, no cast shadows or backgrounds. DO NOT assemble a character, DO NOT mirror any piece. Repaint the existing pieces with hand-painted gouache and ink in approved hollow porcelain wolf style: ivory cracked porcelain, desaturated grey fur, aged brass accents, slate blue clothing. Preserve articulation edges and expression shapes. No new items, missing pieces or connected parts. Sheet 0. Row1: face (keep eye and mouth separate! add small dark hollow cheek crack near jaw, no painted eyes or mouth), fluffy neck, chest leather strap with old brass, waist. Row2: tail grey fur, two ivory ears, tarnished brass shoulder armor. Row3: three slate-blue loincloth panels, leather belt brass buckle. Row4: two sheathed dagger belt ornaments matching original, single curved ivory porcelain saber with dark crimson BLOOD along blade edge near pointed right tip (NO hanging or floating drops baked in), original shadow. Keep mouth and eye absent from face because they are separate animated pieces.
